citation: [2140 S. Prairie Ave. (Tucker / Smith house).] Photograph of the house from the Prairie Avenue roadway south-east of it; unknown photographer, undated (after 1890). Reproduced on chicagology.com, Prairie Avenue, 2140 S. Prairie (second photograph).
author: unknown photographer
repository: chicagology.com (secondary reproduction; the original holder is not named). Prairie library image a20-chicagology-2140-photo-b (stream-2000-2100.json).
locator: The foreground: a post fire hydrant at the left edge on the parkway toward 22nd Street, wooden tree guards, and a cast-iron gas lamp at right on the parkway at the Prairie Avenue porch.
rights_note: A secondary web reproduction whose original source and rights are not stated (the Prairie library's ruling: 'unknown - link only'). Only what stands in the street and where is read from it; nothing is derived from the image as an asset.
access_notes: Read 2026-10-27 (T-3199) from the image store's reference copy (kevinrhaas/chicago-images, prairie-1904/files/a20-chicagology-2140-photo-b.jpg); the original host is not reachable from the build containers.
note: The hydrant is the same post type as the one at Pullman's corner (ghm_blog_pullman_completed): a barrel on a flared foot under a domed bonnet.
what_it_supplies: a post fire hydrant on the west parkway of Prairie Avenue near 22nd Street
a gas lamp on the parkway at the porch of 2140
